echo page=$(curl -s -k -m 5 https://172.28.86.40/ | grep -c 'app-7448ded5') ) >/tmp/.sre_tcp_appmisc 2>&1 & wait ); echo "===legacy"; cat /tmp/.sre_tcp_legacy; echo "===redis"; cat /tmp/.sre_tcp_redis;
